Metadata.title: Dindin — budget-envelope money management
Metadata.description: Organize your income and spending into categorized budget envelopes, with subscriptions and installment purchases posted for you. Free app by Café Labs, available on the web.

Hero.title: Budget-envelope money management
Hero.description: Income comes in, gets allocated across categories, and spending comes out of each envelope. That simple.

Features.item1Description: Every deposit is split across your envelopes on the spot, no spreadsheet and no manual math.
Features.item2Description: Every expense comes out of the right envelope, so you always know what's left to spend in each category.
Features.item3Description: Export all your data as JSON whenever you want, and import it back to migrate between accounts.
Features.item4Description: Set it up once and every charge lands on the right date, out of your account or whichever envelope you pick. Paid an installment early? The purchase just ends sooner.

DeleteAccount.title: Delete your Dindin account
DeleteAccount.metaDescription: How to delete your Dindin account and all the data stored in it — from the app or by email. No login is required to use this page.
DeleteAccount.developerValue: Café Labs, operada por Felipe Portes Antunes
DeleteAccount.intro: This page explains how to request deletion of your Dindin account and of all the data stored in it. You do not need to log in to use this page.
DeleteAccount.exportBody: Deletion is permanent and irreversible — there is no deactivated account that can be recovered later. If you want to keep your records, open Dindin and use Settings → Export JSON before requesting deletion. The resulting file is yours, in an open and readable format.
DeleteAccount.inAppStep1: Open Dindin on your phone or at <app>app.dindin.cafelabs.net</app> and sign in.
DeleteAccount.inAppStep4: Confirm. Deletion starts right away and cannot be undone.
DeleteAccount.inAppFallback: Can't find that option in the version of the app you're using? Use Option 2 below — it works just as well.
DeleteAccount.emailTitle: Option 2 — by email, no app access needed
DeleteAccount.emailBody: Write to <mail>privacidade@cafelabs.net</mail> from the email address registered on your account, asking for deletion. You do not have to give a reason.
DeleteAccount.emailBodyTemplate:
Hello,

I request the deletion of my Dindin account and of all the data stored in it.

Email registered on the account: 

Thank you.
DeleteAccount.emailDeadline: Requests are answered within 15 days, as required by the Brazilian data protection law (LGPD, Law 13.709/2018).
DeleteAccount.emailIdentity: If you can't write from the registered email address, say in the message which one it is. We may need to confirm the account is yours before deleting it — precisely to stop someone else from erasing your data.
DeleteAccount.deletedItem1: Your login account — email, password and, if you signed in with Google, the link to that Google account.
DeleteAccount.deletedItem2: All your envelopes ("caixinhas"), including name, limit, goal and settings.
DeleteAccount.deletedItem4: All allocations and transfers between envelopes.
DeleteAccount.deletedItem8: All balances — the account balance and every envelope balance.
DeleteAccount.deletedOutro: None of it becomes a deactivated account that can be reopened later, and none of it is handed over to anyone else.
DeleteAccount.retainedItem1: Infrastructure backups: copies already taken expire within the provider's cycle of up to 30 days and are not restored. After that cycle, no copy of your data remains.
DeleteAccount.retainedItem2: A record that the deletion happened: only the fact that a deletion occurred is kept, without your personal data, for 5 years, to prove compliance with the law.
DeleteAccount.retainedOutro: Dindin is not a financial institution, issues no tax documents and records no regulated transaction — so there is no legal obligation to retain your financial records, and a deletion request is honoured in full.
DeleteAccount.contactBody: Privacy and personal data: <privacy>privacidade@cafelabs.net</privacy>. Anything else: <general>contato@cafelabs.net</general>.
DeleteAccount.contactPolicy: How your data is processed is described in full in the <link>Privacy Policy</link> (available in Portuguese only).
